The length of the bed and banks in contact with the water across one cross-section.
Float and stopwatch over a measured distance (repeat, take the mean) or a flow meter at a chosen depth.
Ranging poles at set distances or breaks of slope along a transect; clinometer for angles; tape for distance.
A square frame used to sample vegetation or pebbles in a fixed area, often recording percentage cover.
A line along which measurements are taken at regular intervals.
notes: Across a river, up a beach or through vegetation.

Thermometer (temperature), anemometer (wind speed), hygrometer or wet-and-dry bulb (humidity), rain gauge (rainfall).
notes: Same height and time at every site.
